disambiguation: Not just a prompt storage system; it is an execution engine that runs AI actions on selected text or scripts.
extras: Keys are stored in a local secret file (secret.json) and should not be committed to git or synced.
problem: Users need a centralized way to manage multiple AI providers and execute complex AI actions on specific note content or code.
summary: A centralized tool for managing AI providers, API keys, and reusable prompts, allowing users to run AI actions on selected text or scripts.
